name: OpenDota API
summary: Open-source Dota 2 statistics API: matches parsed from replays, players, pro players, heroes, items and constants.
description: OpenDota serves Dota 2 match data including replay-parsed details (teamfights, timelines, item and ability usage), player profiles with win/loss and heroes played, the pro-player and pro-match feeds, hero and item constants, rankings and distributions, plus a SQL explorer endpoint. A free key raises limits.

auth.notes: Works without a key; docs say a registered key increases rate limits and usage.

rate_limit.summary: Keyless limits seen in response headers today: 60 requests per minute (x-rate-limit-remaining-minute 59 after the first call) and 3000 per day (x-rate-limit-remaining-day 2999).

endpoints.summary: Hero pick/win statistics by rank bracket

license.name: Not stated; Dota 2 game data belongs to Valve

agent_notes: account_id is the 32-bit Steam friend id (steamid64 minus 76561197960265728). Cache /constants/* and /heroes: they only change with game patches.
caveats: Daily keyless budget is small (3000/day today); register a key for bulk use.
The CORS header reflected the request Origin on both origins tested.
Heavy endpoints (/matches, /players) are slower than the constants.

verification.notes: Example executed without a key; OpenAPI spec returned by GET /api.
